description: The talking-head cleaner (15 credits), like 1of10's AutoCut: silences tightened, retakes, false starts, stutters and fillers cut with a reason on every cut, other microphones or cameras synced to the first, as Premiere XML, FCPXML and a CMX 3600 EDL. Takes 1 to 4 file_id values staged with POST /v1/clean/files (a chat cannot send the file itself). Runs as a job; get_call reads it. Same as POST /v1/clean.
